source: User-supplied Pro recommendation, independently qualified in follow-up analysis
basis: One shared sequentially generated Ridge prediction archive; past issued forecasts immutable
objective: mean_b L_b(a) + lambda * J(a) + epsilon * squared_norm(a)
constraints: For each of six historical blocks: L_b(a) - L_b(0) <= tau
scale: Frozen training-only h-step squared-change scale; inner folds use their own past-only scale
feedback_event_id: origin_index:horizon:target_index; target_index <= current_index required before update
first_phase: Validation-only Ridge mechanism screening before strong-model expansion or historical test scoring
selection_rule: No price smoothing, no removal by future variation; no quantity-based deletion for reported-price target
gdea_data_scope: local-only candidate on frozen observation axis; target/version/use contract unresolved
author_data_scope: author-level exploratory benchmark with unresolved product/roll/price semantics
